notes.title: New update Version 0.15.2
notes.content:
Hello. Here is bugfix update for you. Here is full changelog:


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
- When favorited, the fighters card would turn finnish. Not anymore.

- There was no limit on how many fighters could be favorited. It's now set to 4.

- If fighter still had more than 20weeks of contract left, you could circumvent the ban to offer a new contract by asking the fighter for a counter offer.

- Activating minotaurs special skill would turn all buttons green.

- A back button wasn't working from team profile window in some case.

- During fight, fighters names could be displayed outside the intended area

- Debug data left visible, cleaned up now

- In team profile, History button was wrongly displayed as My mail.

- At the end of a fight, the winning teams name would sometimes be wrong

- CUP win celebration window would display fighters buried in ground

- Sponsorship payment mails were written in finnish

notes.title: Small roadmap 2019
notes.content:
Hello! You wanted to get roadmap so here is little roadmap what i have planned. You can check roadmap from website too. There i will update always when coming something new ideas from you guys!

[url=http://gloryhonor.sug-oy.fi/#roadmap_eng]Checkout roadmap from website[/url]

[h1]Q1 2019 (01/01/2019 - 03/31/2019)[/h1]
- I have decided to focus on throughout the first half of 2019, only fixing bugs, as well as the development of balance. I want to avoid a situation where there are numerous features in the game and nothing works.

- Updating contract negotiations. The intention would be to develop contract negotiations a bit more interesting. So you could make separate promises to the fighter. This could make it possible to get a little better fighter for inferior sets.

- UI will get some improvements. But not big in this point.


[h1]Q2 2019 (4/1/2019 - 6/30/2019)[/h1]
- I have designed the Q2 phase of the game feature phase. The purpose is to publish a team multiplayer. That is, you get your own team online game where you can fight against other players teams. You can also develop your own fighters like in single-player mode.

- There is also planned that there would be a series of online games you can participate in, but this release can stretch until Q3. Depending on how unproblematic the online game release will be.

- I have also designed a bow in the game as one of the weapon and probably this will be at least in the Beta test. The bow is designed to not be able to shoot in the next box from player, but if there is at least one square between the shooter and target, shooting is possible.

- Development of training. This is player asked feature. That the fighters also get XP in the battles. I have decided to bring this feature to the game.

- Lend. Even more has been asked and I have decided to bring it to at least test. That is, for example, a feature that allows you to put your own juniors into worse leagues to fight so they can increase their experience.

notes.title: Small bugfix pack V.0.15.1
notes.content:
Hello. Here is first update in this game. There was little problem with UI and here is more like a hotfix pack for those bugs.


- If you opened arena editor. Game crashed.
- In fight top corner had some missing texts.
- When you try save your game by pressing "save" button you had to press last half of button because text field was under button.
- If you don't have mana points to make some magic tricks UI in fighter card was totally brake.



Let's go on with bug finding. We will release soon video "Developper playing game" in our youtube channel. Go and but subscribe so you will get notification when video is out!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCc8x6xVjw_w6-t0QmiC4j4w]SugGames YouTube channel[/url]

notes.title: Game is out. What next couple updates will be?
notes.content:
Game is out now! I hope you players will like the game. And i hope that i will get much feedback from you where you like to see this game developing go.

Most important think in this point is that i want to know UI mechanics. Tell me what works and what doesn't so i can fix and make UI better.

Bugs are very important in list so you can report bugs too. We have now 10 bugs in our list and next update will be here sooner you think. 

Next few updates will be max priority to UI and Bugs, but then i will bring more features. Here is small list what i have planned.

- New animations
- More weapons
- More protectors
- Possible to add manager later in game.
- More statics what you can follow.


I hope you enjoy and i waiting your ideas here.
